headline: Junior Agentic AI Engineer
summary: AI Engineering graduate with distinction who builds agentic applications and reliable Python backends. Hands-on work includes tool calling, multi-step orchestration, RAG, vector retrieval, persistent sessions, guardrails, evaluation, containers, APIs, and cloud ML delivery. Combines applied AI depth with full-stack engineering and experience translating unfamiliar problems into working systems.
internship_bullets: Built a Python pipeline for echocardiographic DICOM studies using computer vision and OCR, with structured outputs for downstream research use.
Converted an open-ended problem into resumable processing, validation queues, review tooling, logging, and a documented cross-platform handoff.
Optimised a metadata-guided OpenCV source-video matcher from roughly 21 hours to 23 minutes on one representative run.
apolloon_bullets: Built a paid full-stack operations system with React, TypeScript, Express, Electron, SQLite, tRPC, and Socket.IO.
Implemented API-driven workflows, realtime synchronisation, LAN discovery, replicated hot-standby failover, monitoring, and operator-safe recovery.
